rawContent: I’m here for this. She said start the negotiations. A lot of other White ppl haven’t said anything about #Reparations during this time other than #ADOS fam. Like I said, if your maxim is #BlackLivesMatter it must include a demand of reparations for ADOS.

What happens when the police beat a Black person on #BlackLivesMatter street...let me know when the movement gears toward demanding real structural policy changes that will alter inequality for native Black Americans...#Reparations #ADOS

Your favorite popular #BlackLivesMatter activist hasn’t said a word about #reparations for #ADOS...Process that for a minute...If your maxim is Black Lives Matter, understand that reparations cannot be absent in your fight for justice.
